entry_gate: Run only after B2 probability architecture survives 2024 fixed confirmation.
deployable_price_requirement: timestamped pre-race offered odds; final_sp cannot establish deployable POT
reliability_candidates: NONE_IN_BASELINE_B3; any reliability-gated policy is a separately named future challenger
anti_overfit_rules: No threshold may be selected using 2023, 2024, or sealed years; 2022 selects once.
2022 selection requires at least 50 bets and positive POT.
Frozen policy must have at least 50 bets and positive POT in 2023; pooled 2022-23 requires at least 150 bets and positive POT.
Positive pooled development profit must not be supplied more than 80% by one SP band.
Frozen-policy 2024 confirmation requires at least 100 bets, positive POT, and max drawdown <= max(25 units, 25% of 2024 bets).
Deployment claim requires separate timestamp-safe offered-odds evidence.
